strategy("vol_squeeze__squeeze_threshold0.35_volume_z_threshold1.0_window30", overlay=true, process_orders_on_close=true)
basis = ta.sma(close, 30)
dev = ta.stdev(close, 30) * 2.0
upper = basis + dev
lower = basis - dev
bandwidth = (upper - lower) / basis
squeeze = ta.percentrank(bandwidth, 80) < 35.0
volZ = (volume - ta.sma(volume, 30)) / ta.stdev(volume, 30)
breakoutHigh = ta.highest(high, 30)[1]
breakoutLow = ta.lowest(low, 30)[1]
trendFast = ta.ema(close, 20)
trendSlow = ta.ema(close, 55)
longCondition = squeeze[1] and close > breakoutHigh and volZ > 1.0 and trendFast > trendSlow
shortCondition = squeeze[1] and close < breakoutLow and volZ > 1.0 and trendFast < trendSlow
if longCondition
    strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long)
if shortCondition
    strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short)
